recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比一般小淋巴球大，細胞質豐富淡藍，內含散在的粗大嗜天青顆粒，核圓至略凹、染色質濃縮，是典型的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium to large lymphocyte, roughly twice the diameter of an erythrocyte
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with low N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleolus
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round to slightly indented nucleus, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered coarse azurophilic granules. Red cells and platelets in the field are unremarkable. A single cell is morphologically consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; distinction between a reactive expansion and T-cell or NK-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia requires absolute LGL counts, flow cytometry and T-cell receptor clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and often lack distinct azurophilic granules.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles rather than a few coarse granules.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin and no azurophilic granules.
Granulocytic precursors have more numerous granules, a Golgi hof and less condensed chromatin with nucleoli.
